Flanger.SPEED: LFO rate; 0.01-10 Hz, or bars/beats when tempo-synced
Flanger.DELAY TIME: Base delay the modulation sweeps around; 0-20 ms, but display reads 50x too high
Flanger.FEEDBACK: Share of output fed back into the module; 0-100 %
Flanger.MIX: Level of flanged signal added to the dry signal; not a dry/wet balance

Formant Crusher.FORMANT: Shifts formant frequencies up or down by up to an octave; -100-100 %
Formant Crusher.BITE: Hardens the crusher from smoothed steps to raw sample-and-hold; 0-100 %
Formant Crusher.MORPH: Blend between Filter A and Filter B; 0-100 %

Freq Shifter.MIRROR: Adds mirrored low-end content from shifted partials when enabled
Freq Shifter.COARSE: Shifts all frequencies by a fixed amount in Hz
Freq Shifter.FINE: Shifts all frequencies by a fixed amount in Hz (fine)
Freq Shifter.SPREAD: Adds a shift difference between channels for stereo width; -200-200 Hz
Freq Shifter.FREQ: Split frequency of the -24 dB/oct crossover that preserves original lows; 20-20,000 Hz
Freq Shifter.WET GAIN: Gain of the wet signal; -12-12 dB

Fuzz.MIX: Balance between clean and fuzzed signal; 0-100 %

Gain.VOLUME: Boosts or cuts signal level; +12 dB down to minus infinity

Gate.THRESHOLD: Level above which the gate opens; 0-1
Gate.ATTACK: Speed at which gate begins processing; 0.0001-0.1 s
Gate.RELEASE: Speed at which gate stops processing; 0.01-1 s

Granulizer.DETUNE SPREAD: Detune variation applied to each grain; 0-100 cents
Granulizer.DELAY TIME: How far back in captured audio grains are read; 0-2 s
Granulizer.SPREAD: Variation of the delay time; 0-0.005 s
Granulizer.DIRECTION: Scrub direction; options in order: Forward, Backward, Alternate, Random
Granulizer.DENSITY: Number of overlapping grains; 1-10 (two to twenty grains)
Granulizer.JITTER: Variation in grain playback timing consistency; 0-100 %
Granulizer.FEEDBACK: Share of output fed back into the module; 0-100 %
Granulizer.DENSITY COMPENSATION: Gain compensation for overlapping grains; 0-100 %; hidden from front panel

Guitar Boxes.MIX: Balance between original and amplified signal; 0-100 %
Guitar Boxes.SEPARATION: Delays one channel versus the other to mimic mic distance; -30-30 ms
Guitar Boxes.SPREAD: Stereo spread from mono to full stereo; 0-100 %
Guitar Boxes.MICROPHONE: Mic character; options in order: Dynamic, Condenser, Ribbon

Harmonic Resonators.COARSE: Filter frequency offset per band in semitones
Harmonic Resonators.FINE: Fine frequency offset per band in cents
Harmonic Resonators.COUPLING: Coupling amount; 0-100 %; active only in Reflect and RotCirc modes
Harmonic Resonators.KEY FOLLOW: Enables key tracking; when off, NOTE sets base note
Harmonic Resonators.NOTE: Base note for filters when Key Follow is off
Harmonic Resonators.TONE: High-frequency damping, 440 Hz at 0 % to 20 kHz at 100 %
Harmonic Resonators.DECAY: Ring time of all bands; 20-20,000 ms
Harmonic Resonators.SCALE: Evens band decay times; 0 % favors played note, 100 % equalizes
Harmonic Resonators.COUPLING MODE: Band relationship; options in order: Parallel, Reflect, RotCirc

Harmonizer.WINDOW SIZE: Processing window size for pitch shifting; 10-60 ms
Harmonizer.PITCH: Pitch shift of the voice; +/-12 semitones

IReverb.TIME: Duration of wet signal as a share of the impulse length; 10-100 %
IReverb.PRE DELAY: Delay before wet signal is heard; 0-100 ms
IReverb.LOW DAMP: Fades low band over the tail (positive) or in (negative); -100-100 %
IReverb.HIGH DAMP: Fades high band over the tail (positive) or in (negative); -100-100 %
IReverb.WIDTH: Stereo width of impulse; narrows at negative values, mono at -100 %

LPG.MODE: Chooses what the cell drives; options in order: Lowpass, VCA, Both
LPG.RESO: Emphasizes filter corner; 0-100 %; Lowpass mode only
LPG.GATE: Manual gate opening acting as control voltage; 0-100 %
LPG.SENS: Control voltage at fully open gate; 0-5 V
LPG.AUTO: Drives gate from note on and off, replacing the Gate control
LPG.VEL: Scales automatic gate by note velocity; available only with Auto

Ladder.RESONANCE TRIM: Adds feedback on top of Resonance, up to self-oscillation; 0-50 %
Ladder.GAIN COMPENSATION: Makeup for level lost as resonance rises; 0-100 %
Ladder.OVERSAMPLING TYPE: Sample rate conversion; options in order: Simple, Precise
Ladder.VOLTAGE REF: Level driven into transistor ladder; higher saturates earlier; 0.01-1 V

Magnetic Bass Shaper.DRIVE: Drive applied to the signal; 0-30 dB
Magnetic Bass Shaper.MODEL: Coil magnetization model; options in order: Model C, Model I
Magnetic Bass Shaper.INDUCTOR: Coil choice; options in order: Fasel Red, Fasel Yellow

Maximizer.LOOKAHEAD: Time the module looks ahead at input; 1-20 ms
Maximizer.RELEASE: Speed limiter stops processing after falling below threshold; 0.1-1,000 ms
Maximizer.CEILING MODE: Ceiling method; options in order: Soft, Hard, Brickwall (default)
Maximizer.ATTACK: Gain reduction engage time, used by Soft and Hard only; 0-20 ms, default 0
Maximizer.TRUE PEAK: Inter-sample peak limiting on a 4x sidechain; options in order: Off, On

One Pole.MODE: Filter type; options in order: low-pass, high-pass

Opal.MODEL: Chooses one of seven optical compressor emulations
Opal.PEAK REDUCTION: Sets detection threshold; 0 % is maximal, 100 % is minimal
Opal.RESPONSIVENESS: Multiplies attack and release response times; 0.1-10
Opal.LINK MODE: Stereo link; options in order: Left, Right, Mono, Max ch, Unlinked
Opal.MID PRESENCE: Sidechain filter response, the original emphasis control; 0-100 %
Opal.TREBLE: Treble boost in makeup stage; non-tube path only
Opal.MAKE-UP GAIN: Manual compensation for compressor gain reduction; 0-100 %
Opal.TUBE SIMULATION: Enables tube modeling in makeup stage; more CPU intensive
Opal.DRIVE: Gain into makeup stage when Tube Simulation is active; -40-40 dB
Opal.EXTERNAL: Drives detection from external sidechain input

Overdrive.TRASH: Soft saturation amount; 0 % keeps drive path clean
Overdrive.MIX: Balance between clean and overdriven signal; 0-100 %

Passive EQ.LOW ATTENUATION: Cut at low frequency, centered above the boost; 0-100 %
Passive EQ.LOW FREQUENCY: Frequency for low boost and cut; options in order: 20, 30, 60, 100 Hz
Passive EQ.BANDWIDTH: Width of high peak, sharp to broad; 0-100 %
Passive EQ.HIGH FREQUENCY: Center of high boost peak; options in order: 3, 4, 5, 8, 10, 12, 16 kHz
Frequency high shelf acts on; options in order: 5, 10, 20 kHz

Phasor.NOTCHES: Number of filters in sequence, setting peaks and valleys; 1-12
Phasor.SPEED: LFO rate; 0.01-10 Hz free-running, or tempo-synced
Phasor.LFO SHAPE: LFO waveform; options in order: Triangle, Sine, S&H, Random

Phasor Filter.ORDER: Number of filters in sequence, setting peaks and valleys; 1-12
Phasor Filter.CUTOFF MODE: Notch spacing; options in order: Default (scales with Order), Symmetric (centered on Freq)

Rez Filter.MODE: Filter type; options in order: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass

Rotary.SPEED: Rotary style; options in order: Brake (none), Chorale (slow), Tremolo (fast)
Rotary.DISTANCE: Distance of mics to cabinet; 0.1-2 m
Rotary.ANGLE: Rotates mic pair away from front axis; -100-100 %
Rotary.WIDTH: Angular separation of the two mics; -180 to 180
Rotary.SKEW: Distance disparity between mics and cabinet; -100-100 %

SVF.FILTER MODE: Filter type; options in order: LP, HP, BP, peak, notch
SVF.DRIVE MODE: Overdrive style; options in order: linear, soft

Sallen-Key Filter.KEY TRACKING: Cutoff adjustment relative to played note; 0-100 %
Sallen-Key Filter.SYMMETRY: Diode saturation symmetry, affecting even/odd harmonics; -100-100 %
Sallen-Key Filter.OUTPUT: Tap point; options in order: Soft (filter capacitor), Hard (op-amp output)

Shifter.QUANTIZE: Enables stepped pitch bend when modulating pitch
Shifter.WINDOW SIZE: Processing window size for pitch shifting; 10-60 ms
